description: SQLite database package (db) - Download SQLite amalgamation and implement the db stdlib package with query, row, exec, scalar, and transaction support. This is the foundation other features (sessions) may depend on.
steps: Download SQLite amalgamation (sqlite3.c + sqlite3.h) from https://www.sqlite.org/2024/sqlite-amalgamation-3450000.zip and place sqlite3.c and sqlite3.h into src/ directory. The Makefile wildcard will auto-compile it.

Create src/stdlib_db.c implementing the db package with these native functions: db.open(path) - opens SQLite DB in WAL mode; db.query(sql, params...) - returns list of maps (one map per row, column names as keys); db.row(sql, params...) - returns first row as map or nil; db.exec(sql, params...) - executes statement, returns last insert rowid as int; db.scalar(sql, params...) - returns first column of first row as a value; db.close() - closes the database connection.

Implement parameter binding: support ?, positional params. Bind int (INT_VAL), float (FLOAT_VAL), string (OBJ_VAL string), nil (NULL), bool (0/1 integer). Results: INTEGER->INT_VAL, REAL->FLOAT_VAL, TEXT->OBJ_VAL(ObjString), NULL->VAL_NIL, BLOB->OBJ_VAL(ObjBytes).
Implement db.transaction(closure) - begin transaction, call the closure via vm_call, commit on success, rollback on error. Follow the pattern in stdlib_http_server.c for calling closures.
Register the db package in src/vek_stdlib.c and src/vek_stdlib.h following the existing pattern (create_package + stdlib_db_init declaration).

Update the Makefile to add -lsqlite3 OR compile the amalgamation source directly (since sqlite3.c is in src/, it gets compiled automatically but we need -lpthread -ldl for SQLite). Add -lpthread -ldl to the linker flags.

Create tests/test_db.c with unit tests: open in-memory DB, create table, insert rows, query rows, test parameter binding, test transactions (commit and rollback), test db.scalar, test db.row returning nil for no results.

Create tests/programs/stdlib_db.ve + tests/programs/stdlib_db.expected integration test that exercises the db package from vek code: open a temp DB, create table, insert, query, verify results via print statements.
acceptance_criteria: make clean && make compiles successfully with sqlite3.c included
tests/test_db.c unit test passes (build/test_db runs successfully)
tests/programs/stdlib_db.ve integration test output matches .expected file
db.query returns a list of maps with correct column names and types
db.exec returns the last insert rowid
db.transaction commits on success and rolls back on error
WAL mode is enabled on database open
